scope: Local source verification; no version bump, app installation, push, or release
models: isolated httptest fixtures; no live credentials or external model requests
behaviors: Persisted two-day-old conversation compacts before answering the new message
Summary has no tools; original command evidence and new question are retained
Short or fresh histories do not force an idle handoff
Compaction deadline preserves original history and rollback points; the same session can retry
Failed optional handoff falls back only if original history fits the configured budget
Cancellation starts no answer request; the same session can resume
Restart clears orphaned manual compaction state

ui.method: AITranscript rendered with current built styles and synthetic session data in an isolated loopback fixture; not a native client integration run
